THE NEXT CHAPTER / ROADMAP

Where this goes next.
Not yet built

Directions for Mend after the verified repair loop. These are planned capabilities, not available features.

01
Whole-repo repair

Follow a failure across files and dependencies, beyond a single function.

02
A required CI/CD check

Run inside GitHub Actions and gate changes in the existing delivery workflow.

03
Policy-as-code approval

Auto-approve below a defined risk threshold; require human review above it.

04
A team-wide receipt ledger

Query provenance and verification evidence across every recorded run.

05
Flaky-test detection

Identify inconsistent checks and quarantine them for deliberate review.

06
Receipts inside the IDE

Surface the run, provenance and review context beside the code change.
